description: This Java source file defines the class ClientErrorException, which represents client-side errors resulting from service invocation in the org.eclipse.hono.client package. It extends ServiceInvocationException and provides multiple constructors to instantiate exceptions with error codes, messages, and causes, enforcing that error codes are in the range 400-499.
